stem.en: Priya asks a chatbot how tall a hill near her town is. She asks three times and gets the same number each time. What does this tell her?

text.en: It must be true, since it never changed
The app checked it three times over
It must be false, since models repeat errors
Little, so she should try another source

explanation.en: The same scores can repeat a true fact or a false one, so agreement is not proof. Repeating an answer is not a check, and it does not show the answer is false either. Only a source outside the model can settle it.
